checkedAlternates.risk: Intense mechanical pressure triggers pain nociceptors.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Nociceptors signal tissue-damaging pain (group-3), distinct from non-painful tactile/vibration/acoustic mechanoreceptors (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Cochlear hair cells are specialized cranial sensory cells like retinal rods.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Cochlear hair cells transduce mechanical sound-wave deflections (group-4), not electromagnetic photons (group-1).
